activeQuestion.prompt: Why does the speaker say, “Keep a clear paper trail”?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 說話者為什麼說「Keep a clear paper trail」？

options.text: To make sure the latest sheet replaces all original records.
options.zh: 確保最新版表單取代所有原始紀錄。
options.whyZh: 說話者說線長要歸檔的是同一張表，不是重新抄好的新表。

options.text: To let a later reviewer see the original entry and who corrected it.
options.zh: 讓之後查閱的人能看到原本寫了什麼，以及誰更正的。
options.whyZh: 錯誤只劃一條線，所以原文仍可辨識；在更正處留下姓名縮寫，再保留原表，就能查出誰做了更正。

options.text: To allow absent workers to reuse signatures that are already on file.
options.zh: 讓缺席的員工沿用已歸檔的簽名。
options.whyZh: 說話者明確禁止把簽名抄到新表上，並沒有准許他人沿用。

options.text: To prevent anyone from changing a training record after making a mistake.
options.zh: 防止寫錯後再更動訓練紀錄。
options.whyZh: 規定允許更正：只用一條線劃掉錯誤，並簽上姓名縮寫。不是禁止更正。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 錯誤只劃一條線，所以原文仍可辨識；在更正處留下姓名縮寫，再保留原表，就能查出誰做了更正。
activeQuestion.evidence: On the training sheet, cross out any mistake with one line and initial the correction. The line leader files that same sheet. Don’t copy signatures to a new page.

vocabulary.note: 並非字面上的紙路，而是足以還原某件事的紀錄。
此處作動詞，意指留名確認這次更正。

activeQuestion.difficultyWhy: Infer the audit purpose of the figurative paper trail from correction initials, preserved original, and ban on duplicated signatures. No worker-allocation or stock answer is exposed.

group.title: Assembly shift revision briefing
group.passage: Revision C changes the connector step. To assemble, attend the morning briefing and sign the record. If you miss the briefing, label sealed boxes until the next session. Keep a clear paper trail. On the training sheet, cross out any mistake with one line and initial the correction. The line leader files that same sheet. Don’t copy signatures to a new page. Yesterday’s shortage is over. Fresh stock is cleared for assembly. Yesterday’s opened trays stay on the hold rack until Quality signs their tags. Keep the line working, but use cleared stock only.
group.passageZh: C 版變更了連接器的安裝步驟。要開始組裝，必須先參加早上的說明會，再簽署紀錄。若錯過說明會，就先替已封箱的產品貼標，等下一場。要保留清楚、可追查的書面紀錄。訓練表上若寫錯，只用一條線劃掉錯誤，並在更正處簽上姓名縮寫；線長會把同一張表歸檔。不要把簽名抄到新表上。昨天的缺料已經解決，新補到的庫存已獲放行，可以用於組裝。昨天已拆封的料盤要留在待確認架上，等品管在標籤上簽核。產線要保持運作，但只能使用已獲放行的庫存。
